visual_logic.surface_detail: Large, shimmering 'Chrome Silver' scales with a dark 'Indigo' dorsal ridge; skin appears wet and highly reflective across its full horizontal flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus is on the iconic 'Bulldog' face, with the massive, upturned lower jaw and jagged, unequal fangs completely parallel to the frame edge.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Intimidating and ravenous; small, cold yellow eyes facing laterally with a fixed, predatory stare.

environment.water: Bright turquoise water with intense sun-caustics dancing across the fish's silver flanks.
environment.biota: The panicked school of smaller Hesperornis birds is moved entirely into the background layers to prevent any overlap or clutter along the fish's horizontal silhouette boundaries.

visual_logic.pose: The giant predatory fish is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original high-speed lateral strike angle is stabilized into a straight, level cruising path, allowing the massive fanged skull, elongated torpedo-like body, dorsal fin, and deep homocercal tail fin to extend end-to-end to cleanly trace alongside the central UI measuring tape system. The mouth remains open wide parallel to the frame to reveal the cavernous interior of the jaws.
